**CHR-1257, Stitch Mockups tab (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Comment mode on the mockups canvas: the Comment tool is `pressed` (→ `mockup-comments-thread` leaves the mode); the Comments tool shows the badge "4" (→ `mockup-comments-thread`). Comment mode is a canvas mode, so the right column shows only the folded Agent bar. The banner sits at the bottom of the stage, centred on the columns, above the zoom pill.

---
**Mockup comments: comment mode, new thread in variant C** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261). **One comment mode for all columns**, entered with the Comment tool (pressed, `aria-pressed="true"`) or `C`.

- `comment-mode-banner`: "Comment mode — click an element in any variant to start a thread · Esc to exit". On this view it sits at the bottom of the stage so it never covers a column header.
- Existing pins dim to 0.45 opacity and do not react to clicks.
- Hover over any element in any frame shows `comment-hover-outline` (dashed blue) with the label "<variant letter> · <node-id>". Here that is "B · b-btn-checkout".
- A click selects the element (`comment-hover-outline` variant `target`) and opens `comment-popover` variant `new`. Its title is "New thread" + the `variant-badge`, and its body is a `comment-input` with an @ mention for agents. It flips to the side with room (here left of C's item, over column B).
- Comment posts and leaves comment mode on the new thread (→ `mockup-comments-thread`). Cancel or Esc discards it; a second Esc leaves comment mode.

**A11y:** in comment mode every element in the frames is reachable with Tab in DOM order, column by column. Enter on an element starts a thread. The banner is `role="status"`, so mode changes are announced. Focus goes into the input on open and returns to the element on cancel.
